# Refresh Copilot Instructions

Refresh [copilot-instructions.md](../copilot-instructions.md) with the latest information from the codebase and remove anything that is no longer relevant.

## Steps

1. Walk the current code, infra, and config to identify what has changed since the last refresh.
2. Update sections that are out of date (architecture, resources, package versions, file paths, env vars, commands).
3. Delete sections describing removed features, deleted files, or obsolete patterns.
4. Keep the tone concise and the document grouped by the existing top-level headings.
